book_cn: 外研社版选择性必修第二册
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修第二册 Unit 1 词表(p105 真词);IPA 英音标准词典回填;例句原创、成长/成年/责任主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Growing up, I learned that integrity means doing the right thing even when no one is watching.
words.example_cn: 在成长过程中,我懂得正直就是即使无人在看也做对的事。

words.example_en: Patience is a virtue that we slowly develop as we grow up.
words.example_cn: 耐心是一种我们在成长中慢慢培养的美德。

words.example_en: When I turn 18, I can finally apply for a driving licence.
words.example_cn: 等我满18岁,终于可以申请驾照了。

words.example_en: He took out a bank loan to pay for his very first apartment.
words.example_cn: 他申请了一笔银行贷款来支付自己的第一套公寓。

words.example_en: Once you reach the right age, you can vote in a general election.
words.example_cn: 一旦到了规定年龄,你就能在大选中投票。

words.example_en: Now that I earn a wage of my own, I have learned to budget carefully.
words.example_cn: 如今我有了自己的工资,学会了精打细算。

words.example_en: Adults who earn a wage are expected to pay tax to the government.
words.example_cn: 有收入的成年人都要向政府纳税。

words.example_en: Her mother is an ambulance driver and has seen many road accidents.
words.example_cn: 她妈妈是救护车司机,目睹过许多交通事故。

words.example_en: Eighteen is the legal age for getting a driving licence in many countries.
words.example_cn: 在很多国家,18岁是领取驾照的法定年龄。

words.example_en: I believe I am mature enough to take responsibility for my own life.
words.example_cn: 我相信自己已足够成熟,能为自己的人生负责。

words.example_en: I expected to feel instantly different on my eighteenth birthday.
words.example_cn: 我以为18岁生日那天会立刻感到不一样。

words.example_en: Growing up is a gradual change rather than a sudden one.
words.example_cn: 成长是一种逐渐的变化,而非突然的转变。

words.example_en: I made the decision on my own, though I knew my parents would approve.
words.example_cn: 这个决定是我独自做的,尽管我知道父母会赞成。

words.example_en: On a librarian's salary, Morgan still lives at home with his parents.
words.example_cn: 靠图书管理员的工资,摩根仍和父母住在家里。

words.example_en: Now that I work, I help to pay the household bills every month.
words.example_cn: 如今我工作了,每月都帮忙支付家庭账单。

words.example_en: Renting a flat is a big commitment that I do not feel ready to make.
words.example_cn: 租房是一项重大的承诺,我还没准备好。

words.example_en: Choose a suitable title for the passage about turning eighteen.
words.example_cn: 为这篇关于年满18岁的文章选一个合适的标题。

words.example_en: Do you think the minimum age limits for voting are sensible?
words.example_cn: 你认为投票的最低年龄限制合理吗?

words.example_en: As life goes on, we are offered more and more varied experiences.
words.example_cn: 随着生活继续,我们会遇到越来越多样的经历。

words.example_en: Living away from home, I had to get used to a brand-new daily routine.
words.example_cn: 离家生活后,我不得不适应全新的日常作息。

words.example_en: A boa constrictor swallows its food whole and does not chew it at all.
words.example_cn: 蟒蛇把食物整个吞下,根本不咀嚼。

words.example_en: After a huge meal, the snake sleeps for months during digestion.
words.example_cn: 饱餐一顿后,蟒蛇在消化期间会睡上好几个月。

words.example_en: It takes the snake six months to digest such a large animal.
words.example_cn: 蟒蛇要花六个月才能消化掉这么大的动物。

words.example_en: The grown-ups were always concerned with matters of consequence.
words.example_cn: 大人们总是只关心要紧的事。

words.example_en: Find evidence in the passage to support the author's attitude to grown-ups.
words.example_cn: 在文中找出证据来支持作者对大人的看法。

words.example_en: The grown-up only wanted to talk about golf and politics.
words.example_cn: 那个大人只想聊高尔夫和政治。

words.example_en: He brought himself down to their level and chatted about golf and ties.
words.example_cn: 他迁就他们的水平,聊起了高尔夫和领带。

words.example_en: Fine, don't buy me an airline ticket — I'll just swim across the ocean!
words.example_cn: 行,别给我买机票了——我游过大洋去好了!

words.example_en: We form special bonds with others by caring for them and taking responsibility.
words.example_cn: 我们通过关心他人、承担责任而与他人建立特殊的纽带。

words.example_en: In the conclusion of his review, he recommends the book to readers of every age.
words.example_cn: 在书评的结尾,他把这本书推荐给各个年龄段的读者。

words.example_en: In most countries, turning eighteen marks the start of adulthood.
words.example_cn: 在大多数国家,年满18岁标志着成年的开始。

words.example_en: Reaching this milestone, the age of majority, brings new responsibilities.
words.example_cn: 到达这一里程碑——成年——会带来新的责任。

words.example_en: On that day I felt as if I had closed the door on my childhood.
words.example_cn: 那天我感觉自己仿佛关上了通往童年的门。

words.example_en: Even after turning eighteen, there were still rules to obey.
words.example_cn: 即便满了18岁,仍有规则要遵守。

words.example_en: The change has been more subtle and gradual than I had imagined.
words.example_cn: 这种变化比我想象的更微妙、更循序渐进。

words.example_en: Instead of being the selfish teenager I used to be, I now think of others.
words.example_cn: 我不再是从前那个自私的少年,如今会替别人着想。

words.example_en: I don't have a steady income yet, so a credit card could be risky.
words.example_cn: 我还没有稳定的收入,所以信用卡可能有风险。

words.example_en: A credit card might tempt me to spend more money than I really have.
words.example_cn: 信用卡可能会诱惑我花掉超过自己所有的钱。

words.example_en: Because my commute to work is expensive, I find it hard to save money.
words.example_cn: 由于上班的路程花费很高,我很难存下钱。

words.example_en: I could get a loan to pay the deposit on my very own apartment.
words.example_cn: 我可以贷款来支付自己公寓的押金。

words.example_en: Whatever our choices are, we should cherish these moments in life.
words.example_cn: 无论我们做什么选择,都应珍惜生命中的这些时刻。

words.example_en: Share a most memorable moment from your life with your partner.
words.example_cn: 和同伴分享你生命中最难忘的一个时刻。

words.example_en: Some moments of growing up are bittersweet, both happy and a little sad.
words.example_cn: 成长中的有些时刻是苦乐参半的,既快乐又略带伤感。

words.example_en: A boa constrictor can swallow a small animal whole.
words.example_cn: 蟒蛇能把一只小动物整个吞下。

words.example_en: The snake swallows its prey without chewing it first.
words.example_cn: 蟒蛇不先咀嚼就把猎物吞下。

words.example_en: As a child, the author proudly showed his masterpiece to the grown-ups.
words.example_cn: 作者小时候曾自豪地把自己的杰作拿给大人看。

words.example_en: As a boy he would ponder deeply over the adventures of the jungle.
words.example_cn: 小时候,他会对丛林历险深深地思索。

words.example_en: The grown-ups only wanted to talk about golf and neckties.
words.example_cn: 大人们只想谈论高尔夫和领带。
